pull.title: jobs: add proposal-based requester selection
pull.body:
## Summary
- add explicit `INSTANT` and `PROPOSALS` job assignment modes while keeping `INSTANT` as the backward-compatible default
- let requesters independently enable price negotiation only for proposal-based jobs
- add private proposal submit/list/withdraw/accept APIs with one proposal per worker/job
- prevent proposal-mode jobs from bypassing requester selection through the legacy direct-accept endpoint
- keep competitor proposals private: the requester sees all, another worker sees only their own
- re-check bilateral user blocks on proposal submission and acceptance
- atomically reconcile existing escrow to the accepted proposal amount before assigning the worker
- debit only the extra escrow delta for a higher accepted price, refund only the excess for a lower price, and roll back selection when the requester cannot fund the delta
- add dedicated escrow-adjustment ledger types and human-readable wallet labels
- preserve normal tracking/completion/dispute/payment lifecycle after proposal acceptance
- add Flyway V35, focused proposal/escrow tests and product/privacy documentation

## Product model
This is deliberately not a full Fixly-style bidding replacement. Simple errands can remain `INSTANT`: a requester posts e.g. 30 PLN and the first eligible person may take the job. `PROPOSALS` is opt-in for work where the requester wants to choose the worker. Even in `PROPOSALS`, price can remain fixed; negotiation is a separate requester-controlled flag.

## Escrow safety
The published price is still held when the job is created. Proposal acceptance adjusts that already-held escrow **before** assignment. A 30 PLN job accepted at 42 PLN locks only 12 PLN more; accepting at 25 PLN returns 5 PLN. If the requester cannot fund an increase, the transaction rolls back and the job stays open.

## Privacy / safety
- proposal messages and amounts are not public discovery data
- workers cannot inspect competitors' proposals
- proposal endpoints expose public user ids only, never email, exact location, verification documents, wallet/payment data or moderation data
- proposal mode does not grant exact job-location or live-tracking access before assignment
- blocking is enforced both when submitting and when turning an old proposal into an active transaction

## Compatibility
Existing clients that omit `assignmentMode` continue to create `INSTANT` jobs. The current web create-job flow therefore keeps working unchanged; a following frontend PR will expose requester mode/negotiation controls and proposal UX.

## Validation
Run Maven verify, frontend audit/lint/build, Flyway/runtime smoke and Payments ledger smoke. Do not merge unless the latest head is fully green.
